original_test_intent: Run the approved DCGM PCIe diagnostic scope and verify every target GPU path maintains expected enumeration, negotiated speed/width and error-free link health.
original_method: Map GPU UUID/BDF through bridges and root ports; record expected/actual speed/width and AER/link counters; pin driver/DCGM and script revision; preserve logs; resolve level 4 versus PCIe group level 2 and required service/persistence setup; isolate workloads, run the selected diagnostic once, compare all links/counters and recover any retrain or downgrade.
manual_activity: PCIe/GPU owner selects the authoritative diagnostic level, approves topology-specific link oracle and retrain/recovery limits; operator isolates workloads and monitors OOB health.
required_inputs: Expected negotiated speed/width and AER baseline
Pinned reviewed internal script revision or equivalent command
Selected level 4 or level 2 scope and setup
Isolation, monitoring, abort and recovery plan
safety_requirements: Do not run both levels by assumption
Preserve AER/link counters and complete output
Use authenticated access without embedded credentials
Stop on retrain, downgrade, disappearance or new AER
Restore runtime/link health and never auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify topology, baseline and selected diagnostic scope
Correlate subtests with paths and error deltas
Recover/restore and report without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Choose authoritative level and link oracle
Classify new link errors and set verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its level-2 PCIe group may be suitable but conflicts with the source level-4 procedure and omits setup, topology and safety evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Execute exactly one engineer-selected level using a pinned command/script after full PCIe baseline, retaining every subtest and post-link counter.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PCIe diagnostic intent, 120-minute allocation and per-subtest PASS criterion remain; level is held pending decision rather than silently changed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Tie each PCIe subtest to an explicit GPU-to-root-port path and accept only if speed/width and error counters remain within approved baseline after the selected scope.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds topology attribution, level decision, pinned script, link-delta oracle and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Level 2 and level 4 are not interchangeable; the selected coverage must be explicitly recorded.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Diagnostics may retrain or stress links, expose AER faults, downgrade a path or disrupt workloads.

project_override_considerations: Engineering must decide whether the internal script implements source level 4, DeepSeek PCIe level 2 or additional checks, and define optional topology elements and allowed corrected-error deltas.
expected_evidence: GPU/BDF/bridge/root-port map and expected link capabilities
Pre/post negotiated speed/width and AER/link counters
Pinned script hash or exact command plus full output/exits
Recovered links/runtime state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source specifies level 4 plus persistence/service setup, whereas DeepSeek specifies level 2 without that setup; service also appears after diagnostic in the source sequence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution blocks if authoritative level, script behavior, topology oracle, link-impact boundary or recovery cannot be established.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row361 Wistron-NV GPU-00354-V003: choose source `dcgmi diag -v -r 4` or DeepSeek PCIe `-r 2` and required setup; approve pinned internal script revision, GPU-BDF-root-port topology, expected speed/width, AER/error delta limits, workload isolation, abort and link recovery while preserving logs.

review_improvement: Replaces an untracked level substitution with an explicit scope decision and path-by-path PCIe acceptance evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A PCIe plugin PASS is insufficient when a link retrains at lower width or accumulates corrected errors. The test oracle must follow each GPU path before and after the run, correlate subtests and AER deltas, and preserve the deliberate choice between level 2 and the broader source level 4.
